name: South Miami
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in South Miami, FL 2026
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in South Miami, FL: Santa's Workshop and the Parade of the Elves on Sunset Drive, a free tradition with a toy drive.
lede: South Miami celebrates on Sunset Drive with Santa's Workshop and the Parade of the Elves, a ten year tradition that is free for families.
celebrates: South Miami's Christmas centers on Sunset Drive. Miami Kids Magazine hosts Santa's Workshop, with holiday character photos, arts and crafts, games, music, entertainment and giveaways, followed by the Parade of the Elves, with festive floats, holiday characters and Santa and Mrs. Claus on the magazine's float. The City of South Miami lists the parade on its own events calendar, where earlier entries describe local groups marching down Sunset Drive from US 1 to Red Road to welcome Santa to town. Families are asked to bring a new, unwrapped toy for the holiday toy drive.
lastyear: The City of South Miami's calendar listed Santa's Parade of the Elves for Sunday, December 7, 2025, from 12 to 3 pm. Earlier city calendar entries describe Santa's Workshop from 12 to 2 pm at Sunset Drive and 58th Avenue, then the parade at 2 pm as local groups march down Sunset Drive from US 1 to Red Road. The host, Miami Kids Magazine, also publishes a recap video for 2025 on its event page.
facts: The city's history page notes that the great hurricane of September 1926 dealt a punishing blow to the Town of South Miami, and the City of South Miami was born afterward. City Hall sits at 6130 Sunset Drive, on the street that hosts the parade. Miami Kids Magazine says Santa's Workshop and the Parade of the Elves has been held for ten years and draws 5,000 to 15,000 guests each year.
trains: South Miami has its own Metrorail station on the Green Line, with a South Miami address on the county's station list, and Dadeland North and Dadeland South stations also serve the area. The county notes that Metrorail opened in 1984 and ran from Overtown to Dadeland South. Brightline's MiamiCentral station is at 161 NW 6th Street in Miami. For a bigger train day, the Gold Coast Railroad Museum in Miami has its own page on our site.
train_links: Miami's railroad museum, with its own Christmas train page on our site.
traditions: Crafts, games, music, giveaways and holiday character photos on Sunset Drive.
Floats, holiday characters and Santa and Mrs. Claus on the Miami Kids Magazine float.
Families bring a new, unwrapped toy to bring joy to children this season.
Visit with Santa and Mrs. Claus
Kids can visit Santa and Mrs. Claus at the workshop.
kidfact: In South Miami, a parade of elves marches down Sunset Drive to welcome Santa to town.
faq: Is Santa's Workshop in South Miami free?
Yes. Miami Kids Magazine says the celebration is free for everyone. Families are asked to bring a new, unwrapped toy for the holiday toy drive, which supports children and families in the community.
Where is the Parade of the Elves?
The parade rolls down Sunset Drive in South Miami, from US 1 to Red Road, which is also SW 57th Avenue. Santa's Workshop sets up on the same street before the parade.

The host lists holiday character photos, arts and crafts, games, music, entertainment and giveaways, plus the chance to visit Santa and Mrs. Claus. Our South Miami card lists the exact 2026 date and times.
Is there a Metrorail station in South Miami?
Yes. Metrorail's Green Line has a South Miami station, and Dadeland North and Dadeland South stations are close by. The county's Metrorail page describes the line from Palmetto to Dadeland South.
